title: Font declaration
description: One font role (display, heading, body or mono) and where it comes from (ADR-017). Shared by brand files and design system files.

family.description: The family name as CSS uses it, e.g. "IBM Plex Sans".

fallback.description: Fallback stack after the family, ending in a generic family (sans-serif, serif or monospace).

license.description: Required for bundled fonts: only these licences may be shipped in an SDK package.

url.description: Required for client-hosted fonts: the stylesheet that declares the font.
